title: 第十章 哥哥，你可以喂我吗
content_zh:
后来他顺利当上霍氏集团总裁，一门心思为霍氏开疆拓土，两人依旧没多少见面时间。

    现在想想，她和霍廷深其实没什么深度交流，每次见面都很匆忙，两人像是最熟悉的陌生人。

    而刚刚霍廷深坚决不相信自己有工作……他在家的时间是有多短，才发现不了自己的妻子有工作？

    心就这么一点一点冷了下去，她说道：“这样吧，你把杜若依赶出霍家，以后断绝和她的一切往来，我们可以不离婚。”

    她上前一步。

    “你俩成天不清不楚地纠缠，以兄妹之名干着夫妻之事，我忍不了，继续这种生活我不可能不离，所以让我打消离婚的念头也可以，把你的好妹妹赶出去就好。”

    “嫂子。”

    霍廷深还没说话，杜若依先震惊了，“为什么把我赶出去？”

    她眼圈霎时间红了，“哥哥，我不想走，别赶我走好不好？”

    “我在霍家长大，离了霍家我还能去哪？杜家已经没有我的亲人了。”

    霍廷深目光沉沉地盯着宣云溪，她真实想法终于泄露了，这才是她闹离婚的目的吧。

    “若依是霍家人，她不可能离开霍家。”他态度很强势。

    “离婚也不可能，霍家没有离婚的说法。”

    宣云溪冷笑出声，她就是等着霍廷深说这话，她知道霍廷深不会把杜若依赶出去。

    这两人兄妹情深，都深到床上去了，怎么会分开？

    而霍廷深之所以不和杜若依结婚非要娶她，是因为这两人以兄妹之名一起长大，怕光明正大地在一起，会有知情人说闲话吧。

    现在想想，她其实起到了一个挡箭牌的作用。

    “没有离婚的说法？你们霍家喜欢给人判无期徒刑？”她讽刺。

    “你什么意思，和我结婚是坐牢？”

    “坐牢？没那么舒服。”

    “……”

    宣云溪气人的本事越来越大了，霍廷深眯起眼睛看着她。

    宣云溪懒得和他拉扯，扬了扬下巴道：“既然你不同意赶走杜若依，那我们就离婚，这没得商量。”

    她指了指旁边的杜若依，又指了指自己。

    “这个家有她没我，有我没她，你看着办。”
content_en:
Later, he successfully became the president of Huo Group, and he focused on opening up territory for Huo Group, but the two still didn't have much time to see each other.

    Thinking about it now, she and Huo Tingshen actually had no in-depth communication. Every time they met, they were in a hurry. They were like the most familiar strangers.

    And just now Huo Tingshen firmly refused to believe that he had a job... How short of time did he have to be at home to find out that his wife had a job?

    Her heart grew colder little by little, and she said, "Let's do this. You drive Du Ruoyi out of the Huo family and cut off all contact with her from now on. We don't need to divorce."

    She took a step forward.

    "You two have been entangled in confusion all day long, doing things as husband and wife in the name of brother and sister. I can't bear it. It's impossible for me to stay apart if you continue this kind of life, so you can give up the idea of divorce. Just drive your good sister out."

    "Sister-in-law."

    Before Huo Tingshen spoke, Du Ruoyi was shocked, "Why did you drive me out?"

    Her eyes suddenly turned red, "Brother, I don't want to leave, please don't drive me away, okay?"

    "I grew up in the Huo family. Where can I go without the Huo family? The Du family has no relatives of mine anymore."

    Huo Ting stared at Xuanyun Xi with deep eyes. Her true thoughts were finally revealed. This was probably the purpose of her divorce.

    "If Ruoyi is from the Huo family, it is impossible for her to leave the Huo family." His attitude was very strong.

    "Divorce is impossible. There is no such thing as divorce in the Huo family."

    Xuanyunxi sneered. She was just waiting for Huo Tingshen to say this. She knew that Huo Tingshen would not drive Du Ruoyi out.

    The love between these two brothers and sisters is so deep that they even go to bed. How could they be separated?

    The reason why Huo Tingshen did not marry Du Ruoyi but insisted on marrying her was because the two grew up together as brother and sister, and they were afraid that if they were together openly, some insiders would gossip.

    Now that I think about it, she actually acted as a shield.

    "There is no argument for divorce? Do you Huo family like to sentence people to life imprisonment?" she sarcastically said.

    "What do you mean, marrying me means going to jail?"

    "Jail? Not that comfortable."

    "..."

    Xuanyunxi's ability to make people angry became more and more powerful. Huo Ting narrowed his eyes and looked at her.

    Xuan Yunxi was too lazy to argue with him, raised her chin and said: "Since you don't agree to drive away Du Ruoyi, then we will divorce. This is not negotiable."

    She pointed at Du Roy next to her, and then at herself.

    "With or without her in this family, or with me or without her, it's up to you."
title_en: Chapter 10 Brother, can you feed me?
